controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from Gaia's spectrum of the star; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,185 K and log g 4.51 (u1 0.604, u2 0.160): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

physical.credit: Bonomo et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5789 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive radius; Gaia DR3 astrometry; no measured rotation axis (display convention)
